expected_invariant: The catalogue holds exactly the retained findings that carry a counterexample, with their retained labels.
experiment: Collect counterexample findings from the retained reports, recount counterexample keys in the raw report text, and write JSON and Markdown catalogues.
failure_modes_checked: counterexample findings dropped by the traversal (raw-text recount)

checks.reference: catalogue size minus the raw-text count of counterexample keys

findings.claim: Counterexample catalogue lists every retained counterexample finding

uncertainty.basis: integer count over retained report files; no rounding, sampling or tolerance

hypothesis: Every counterexample recorded by a queue task can be collected with its witness and evidence status.
input_data: Retained reports of T001-T156 in the same output directory (findings with a counterexample)
mathematical_model: Catalogue = all retained findings carrying a counterexample statement, keyed by task and claim.
observation_model: No physical observation; reads retained computational records only.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

recommended_next_task: Counterexamples are compared with a fresh run by ciw lab verify in CI (scripts/check_lab.py); optional: name one pytest witness per counterexample in each section's tests, so a counterexample is also guarded outside the clean-room comparison.
tests_passed: check: Counterexample catalogue lists every retained counterexample finding vs catalogue size minus the raw-text count of counterexample keys
title: Maintain a counterexample catalogue.
uncertainty: Exact count; each counterexample carries its own uncertainty in its source report.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether each catalogued counterexample is genuine is not re-judged here; each rests on its source finding's checks.
Counterexamples recorded by T158 and later tasks run after this catalogue and are not in it.
